about: Large files of incognita-emu, published as assets of this repository's GitHub release. Fetch with scripts/fetch_assets.py; sha256 of each downloaded file.

assets.name: models_default
assets.note: Default emulators: 185 nuclei x 9 channels, 12 knobs, training floor 1e-3 mb; trained on engine engine-2026-10-19

assets.name: models_legacy
assets.note: Older emulators (training floor 1e-5 mb); poorer heavy-nucleus (n,alpha) near threshold

assets.name: verify_unseen_2026_10_19
assets.note: 20 exact engine-2026-10-19 runs never used in training (tests of the default models)

assets.name: verify_unseen
assets.note: 30 exact engine-2026-10 runs never used in training (tests of the legacy and 0.1.0 models)

assets.name: models_v0_1
assets.note: The 0.1.0 default emulators (engine engine-2026-10, training floor 1e-3 mb)

assets.name: train_a
assets.note: training runs, 60 nuclei, space-filling design (4,132 runs) (engine engine-2026-10)

assets.name: train_b
assets.note: training runs, random knob points (1,020 runs) (engine engine-2026-10)

assets.name: train_c
assets.note: training runs, 185 nuclei: centre, axis and Sobol points (part 1) (engine engine-2026-10)

assets.name: train_d
assets.note: training runs, 185 nuclei: centre, axis and Sobol points (part 2) (engine engine-2026-10)

assets.name: train_e
assets.note: training runs, extra Sobol points (part 1) (engine engine-2026-10)

assets.name: train_f
assets.note: training runs, extra Sobol points (part 2) (engine engine-2026-10)

assets.name: train16_a
assets.note: runs for the 16-knob set (4 extra knobs; no shipped 16-knob model), part 1 (engine engine-2026-10)

assets.name: train16_b
assets.note: runs for the 16-knob set, part 2 (engine engine-2026-10)

assets.name: sens
assets.note: exact knob sensitivities from the axis runs (no emulator)

assets.name: mf33_demo
assets.note: demo MF33 relative covariances from the knob prior (not a calibrated covariance)

assets.name: lines_P
assets.note: engine input decks V32_ZZZ_AAA.lines for exact runs on engine-2026-10-19 (unpacked to data/lines_P)
